name: senda
description: Lets Claude read and use your browser, with your approval.
long_description: Senda connects Claude to the Senda browser extension, so Claude can open pages, read them, click and type in your own browser, signed in as you. It works only in tabs it opens, inside a visible "🤖 MCP" tab group, and asks you on the page before actions that look like sending, changing or deleting something. Install the Senda extension first, then ask Claude: "Connect Senda".
